# agent-tool-tracer

> Trace every tool call of an agent with redacted arguments, results, timing, cost and errors to JSONL, and render runs as escaped Mermaid sequence diagrams Python package `trysac-agent-tool-tracer`, import name `agent_tool_tracer`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
